items.excerpt: Alle linjene påvirkes midt i morgenrushet.

items.title: Her slår han til igjen: – Hva er det du driver med?
Prisene steg med 3,6 prosent i oktober
items.excerpt: Prisene steg med 3,6 prosent siste tolv måneder, viser tall fra SSB. Prisen på matvarer steg med 1,6 prosent i samme periode. Matvareprisene sank 0,4 prosent fra september til oktober. Kjerneinflasjonen siste 12 måneder var 2,7 prosent.

items.title: Will Australia push for fossil fuel exit at UN talks?
items.excerpt: The heat is on Australia as chief negotiator at the COP31 UN climate conference to forge a path away from coal and gas, and to protect Pacific neighbors facing rising sea levels.

items.title: How Germany's greatest goalscorer is guiding the next generation
items.excerpt: Miroslav Klose rose from amateur to World Cup winner as a player - now the German is forging a similar path as a coach.

items.title: 'No reason' to reopen sandpaper investigation
items.excerpt: Cricket Australia CEO Todd Greenberg says he does not see "any compelling reason" to reopen the investigation into the 2018 Australia ball-tampering scandal.

items.title: US, Russia and Ukraine to restart talks in Abu Dhabi
items.excerpt: Peace talks between Russia, Ukraine and the US are getting underway in the United Arab Emirates. It is the first such meeting since February. DW has the latest updates.

items.title: Australia tightens AI oversight rules after OpenAI government breach
items.excerpt: The decision comes after ​an OpenAI agent breached ​an Australian government website in June.
